prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: desktop wallpaper, landscape 16:9, 3840x2160 if possible. Create a polished original wallpaper inspired specifically by the pioneering computer graphics of TRON (1982). Light cycle arena: three small original 1982 angular light cycles, blue and yellow opaque luminous ribbon trails making right angles across a vast black blue grid. Wide elevated cinematic perspective. Strict early 1980s CGI aesthetic: simple faceted geometry, flat black surfaces, thin luminous edge outlines, restrained optical bloom, deep ink black and cobalt with icy cyan; small selective amber or red accents. Filmic slightly soft luminous edges. Spacious and uncluttered, ample dark negative space for desktop windows. No typography, no logos, no border, no montage, no people. Avoid TRON Legacy styling, modern motorcycles, photorealistic materials, intricate futuristic cities, excessive neon and modern glossy rendering.
